panels.description: Índice de Aptitud Deportiva (IAD) para la ciudad seleccionada. 0=imposible, 10=perfecto.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time AS "time", AVG(score) AS "Running Score"
FROM meteogalicia.iad_running
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND (coord_index = CASE WHEN ${ciudad} = -1 THEN coord_index ELSE ${ciudad} END)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Horas ideales: lluvia improbable, viento suave, buena sensación térmica y de día.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS "Hora",
  ROUND(AVG(apparent_temperature)::numeric, 1) AS "Sens. °C",
  ROUND(AVG(precipitation_probability)::numeric, 0) AS "Lluvia %",
  ROUND(AVG(wind_speed)::numeric, 1) AS "Viento km/h",
  ROUND(AVG(cloud_cover)::numeric, 0) AS "Nubes %",
  CASE
    WHEN AVG(precipitation_probability) < 25 AND AVG(wind_speed) < 30 AND AVG(apparent_temperature) BETWEEN 5 AND 30 AND AVG(is_day) > 0.5
    THEN '✅ Ideal'
    WHEN AVG(precipitation_probability) < 50 AND AVG(wind_speed) < 40
    THEN '⚠️ Posible'
    ELSE '❌ Evitar'
  END AS "Apto"
FROM raw_air.forecast
WHERE time >= NOW() AND time < NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND (coord_index = CASE WHEN ${ciudad} = -1 THEN coord_index ELSE ${ciudad} END)
GROUP BY time
HAVING AVG(is_day) > 0.5
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 🌿 Polen (granos/m³)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE i.coord_index
    WHEN 0 THEN '🏙️ A Coruña' WHEN 1 THEN '🏛️ Santiago' WHEN 2 THEN '⛵ Vigo'
    WHEN 3 THEN '🏰 Lugo' WHEN 4 THEN '♨️ Ourense' WHEN 5 THEN '🌊 Pontevedra'
  END AS "Ciudad",
  ROUND(AVG(w.temperature)::numeric, 1) AS "Temp °C",
  ROUND(SUM(w.precipitation)::numeric, 1) AS "Lluvia mm",
  ROUND(AVG(i.score)::numeric, 1) AS "Score",
  i.label AS "IAD",
  CASE
    WHEN AVG(i.score) >= 7 THEN '✅ ¡Sal a correr!'
    WHEN AVG(i.score) >= 5 THEN '⚠️ Moderado'
    WHEN AVG(i.score) >= 3 THEN '🟠 Precaución'
    ELSE '❌ No recomendado'
  END AS "Recomendación"
FROM meteogalicia.iad_running i
JOIN meteogalicia.weather_hourly w ON i.coord_index = w.coord_index AND i.time = w.time
WHERE i.time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM meteogalicia.iad_running)
GROUP BY i.coord_index, i.label
ORDER BY "Score" DESC
